Granite Comfort

From 9 to 1 Contact Centers

Founded in 2019, Granite Comfort is a PE-backed, residential HVAC and plumbing platform currently operating brands in Texas, Pennsylvania, Illinois, Georgia, North Carolina, and New York. In late 2025, they rebuilt their customer-facing operation around Avoca. Their deployment spanned Avoca Responder, Coach, and Human-in-the-Loop across nine of their brands brands. Nine separate call centers became one. Nine after-hours vendors became zero. And the brand they piloted with, Yost & Campbell, grew revenue 20% year-over-year, primarily from calls Avoca captured that the team was previously losing.
